Question: Can “very small positive numbers” form a set?

Choices.A: Yes, because positive numbers are all well-defined.
Choices.B: No, because “very small” has no clear criterion.
Choices.C: Yes, but it can only be a finite set.
Choices.D: No, because there are infinitely many positive numbers.

Solution: A set requires its objects to be well-defined. Infinitely many objects can form a set, such as all positive integers. However, “very small” has no clear criterion, so these numbers cannot form a set.
